_help: Events calendar. Events move from 'Upcoming' to 'Past' automatically after their date. Fields: id (unique), title, date (YYYY-MM-DD), endDate (optional, multi-day), startTime / endTime (optional, 24h 'HH:MM', local time at the venue), timezone (e.g. 'Europe/Berlin', 'Europe/London', 'Asia/Kolkata'), venue, address (optional), city, country, status ('scheduled', 'cancelled' or 'sold-out'), ticketUrl (optional), description, image (optional), source. Events from a linked Google/Outlook calendar are added automatically (data/events-calendar.json, see README); an event typed here wins if both list the same show.

items.title: Krybaby presents Nihira Joshi Live: Musically Speaking
items.description: A set of semi-classical music, with Madhusoodanan on flute and Narendra Panchal on percussion.
items._note: Date 2023-04-22 confirmed by the site owner (M3). Second Krybaby show ('A tribute to the Mangeshkar sisters', Harrow Arts Centre, https://harrowarts.com/whats-on/event/nihira-joshi-1) still has no confirmed date; not listed.

items.title: SongVersations with Nihira Joshi Deshpande
items.venue: The Cube, Nita Mukesh Ambani Cultural Centre
items.description: An evening of Hindi and Marathi songs, ghazals, Bollywood classics and originals in a 'SongVersations' format of music and conversation, with an all-women ensemble: Shruti Bhave (violin), Darshana Jog (keys, vocal arrangement), Pooja Majumder (bass) and Sapna (percussion).
items._note: Found by web search (M3). Duration 1 h 30 min per the listing, so endTime 21:00. Venue's full name inferred from nmacc.com.
